patent_grounding.rationale: Revision 6 component descriptions and major mechanism/material relationships align with cited claims/description. Reducer is properly described as optional/dependent-claim variant. No fabricated controller or downstream sink.

functional_completeness.rationale: Main chain from motor through gearbox, eccentric link, oscillating shaft, rocker/link assemblies, guided carriage and attached trays is represented; scrap source and press mounting are included. Unspecified controls appropriately omitted.

flow_consistency.rationale: Connected endpoints have matching flow types and compatible directions, including material, rotary, oscillatory, linear, and structural interactions. Oscillation-to-linear transformation resides in rocker/link assembly.

claim_traceability.rationale: Relevant descriptions/requirements and claim-specific gear properties, carriage guidance, progressive transfer, reducer variant and releasable saddle arrangement have patent passage citations. Revision 6 removed the stale warning from revision 5.

interfaces.rationale: Previously missing press mounting, link-to-guide, carriage/shaker shaft/saddles, and saddle/tray connections remain encoded with resolvable compatible endpoints. No interface omission remains.

textbook_application.rationale: Model uses explicit internal interfaces and separates external press/material context, consistent with interface and context guidance. Textbook evidence is not used to establish invention facts.

summary: Independently reviewed saved revision 6 against actual cited patent passages and relevant textbook interface/context guidance. Revision 5's sole finding—the stale warning claiming already-present interfaces were missing—is resolved: revision 6's warning now accurately limits itself to unspecified control logic and optional reducer/direct-drive alternative. Major component, function, flow and interface representations are supported; no remaining repair issue identified.
